_comment: stageDays lists the watered days spent in each visual stage; their sum is time to maturity.

crops.name: Lumen Pod
crops.description: Three days from seed to light. The first thing anyone plants here.

crops.name: Glassroot
crops.description: Five days, and it wants water every one of them.

crops.name: Cinder Moss
crops.description: Needs no water at all. Four dry days and it mats over the tile.

crops.name: Orbit Berry
crops.description: Six days to the first fruit, then two more for every crop after.
